input.summary: Make the cap mutual, set it at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, and add the Excluded Claims carve-outs, indirect/consequential exclusion and payment-obligations statement.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have made the cap mutual and reset the basis to the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, since as drafted only TrueLink is capped while Client's exposure under the Section 12(a) indemnity is unlimited. The added sentence excludes indirect and consequential damages, places confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, fraud and IP infringement claims (alongside the existing gross negligence and wilful misconduct carve-out, now mutual) outside the cap, and confirms Client's payment obligations are not damages.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
ops.newText: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN EXCLUDED CLAIMS OR DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM EITHER PARTY'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim AND (B) USD 1,000,000.

ops.text: "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES. Client's payment obligations, and all amounts due under this Agreement, are not damages for purposes of this limitation.
